item.title: A Day at Hetzner Online in the Falkenstein Data Center
item.description:
📝 This segment shows particularly clearly that Hetzner deliberately relies on functional design and regional suppliers. Anyone interested in infrastructure, technology and data center processes will gain an in-depth insight that goes far beyond what you would expect from the outside. Falkenstein is not an anonymous data location, but a highly organized interplay of production, service, operation and security that is rarely seen in this form.
🔗 Read more: https://www.igorslab.de/en/a-day-at-hetzner-online-in-the-falkenstein-data-center-insights-into-server-technology-cooling-production-rma-and-sustainability/
